general: Always follow the coding standards in .github/copilot-instructions.md
Consider the 8GB RAM constraint in all suggestions
Prioritize local processing - never suggest cloud APIs
Include proper error handling for hardware interactions
Add ROS2 logging for important events
code_review: Check for hardware resource leaks (serial ports, GPU memory)
Verify proper ROS2 node shutdown handling
Ensure all image processing uses undistorted images
Validate UART command formats match Wave Rover spec
Check for proper type hints and docstrings
debugging: Check if model files are loaded correctly
Verify ROS2 topics are publishing/subscribing correctly
Look for memory leaks in long-running nodes
Check thermal throttling if performance degrades
testing: Mock all hardware dependencies in unit tests
Include edge cases and error conditions
Test with realistic data (distorted images, noisy audio)
Check for resource cleanup in tests
